relationships.subject: endometriosis
relationships.evidence_quote: This QST case-control study in endometriosis patients identifies massive pressure hyperalgesia as the most significant somatosensory alteration in the viscerotome of the lower abdomen

relationships.subject: peripheral sensitization
relationships.evidence_quote: This finding highlights the role of peripheral sensitization as the dominant mechanism of endometriosis-related hyperalgesia

key_findings: QST in endometriosis shows regionally restricted pressure hyperalgesia in every patient plus cold hyperalgesia (non-cyclic > cyclic), with somatosensory loss.
Pattern is consistent with peripheral rather than central sensitization; NGF or TRPV1 suppression proposed as preventive targets.
